name: Inspect immutable map fields
command: for c in 'com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMapEntry' 'com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMapEntry$NonTerminalImmutableMapEntry' 'java.util.Map$Entry[]'; do flock -s dumps/run-jfr-38/.matindex.lock java -Xmx3g -jar experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar mat-fields --hprof dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof --class "$c" --limit 3 --all; done
